@sidecar.role: ASX Manager Micronaut factory and worker host contract

@micronaut.definition: Micronaut sidecars declare factory and worker host binaries as local executable contracts. Runtime admission still routes through XCFE/KUHUL phases; cross-micronaut communication uses HTTP, not direct cross-stack paths.
@micronaut.install_rule: Micronauts can be installed per project like ASX MEMORY. Required assets should be copied into the project or ASX Manager data area instead of linking to another skill.

pipeline.name: micronaut_factory_to_bson
pipeline.formula: micronaut factory -> micronaut.json -> SCXQ2 packer -> bson.micronaut.json
pipeline.rule: Factory output is a candidate until validation, SCXQ2 packing, BSON checksum, and Crown policy admission complete.

create.description: Create or update a micronaut from a manifest.

validate.description: Validate a micronaut manifest before execution.

pack_scxq2.description: Pack an admitted micronaut manifest into an SCXQ2 envelope.

bind_bson.description: Bind an SCXQ2 envelope into bson.micronaut.json using glyph + lane + binary runtime array.

console.role: local worker host for admitted micronaut jobs

http.role: localhost worker host for route-mounted micronaut jobs

@folds.pop: read micronaut manifest and local binary availability
@folds.wo: bind factory command, worker transport, routes, and project data root
@folds.yax: validate manifest, worker policy, paths, and route admission
@folds.sek: invoke admitted factory or worker host command
@folds.chen: emit package, worker result, route response, or notification
@folds.xul: record bundle hash, replay metadata, and installation provenance
